assets.furniture: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual game asset atlas for RoomCrew. Match reference's cozy detailed softly painted 2.5D game style and warm top-left lighting, thin colored outlines, muted sage/ivory/warm oak palette. Reference is STYLE ONLY; do NOT draw characters. Genuine alpha transparency, no checkerboard, no background, no floor tiles under objects, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows extending into adjacent cells. Clear separated objects with generous transparent gutters; complete objects fully inside each cell. One square atlas, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows (12 isolated furniture items). Same elevated three-quarter 2:1 isometric view for every object. Row1 left to right: 1 large oak boss desk with monitor/keyboard/papers (NO chair), 2 smaller sage-and-oak employee desk with monitor/keyboard (NO chair), 3 long rectangular meeting table with notebooks and mugs (NO chairs), 4 standalone swivel office chair upholstered sage. Row2: 5 cozy two-seat sage sofa with pillow, 6 low oak coffee table, 7 tall open oak bookcase with books, 8 tall beige metal filing cabinet. Row3: 9 small cream office refrigerator, 10 freestanding large presentation screen/whiteboard, 11 large monstera in terracotta pot, 12 small leafy potted plant. Furniture should have readable wood grain, beveled edges, warm fabric, sensible legs, consistent scale family. Exactly 12 different objects, one in each cell; not a full office scene.

assets.effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual game asset atlas for RoomCrew. Match reference's cozy detailed softly painted 2.5D game style and warm top-left lighting, thin colored outlines, muted sage/ivory/warm oak palette. Reference is STYLE ONLY; do NOT draw characters. Genuine alpha transparency, no checkerboard, no background, no floor tiles under objects, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows extending into adjacent cells. Clear separated objects with generous transparent gutters; complete objects fully inside each cell. This atlas contains small GAME UI STATUS EFFECTS rather than furniture. Exactly FOUR columns and EIGHT rows (32 isolated effect frames). Each row is FOUR progressive subtle animation frames of one effect, read left to right. Row1 warm ivory thought bubble with three sage dots slowly pulsing. Row2 amber speech bubble with a single clear question mark. Row3 coral attention bubble with a single exclamation mark. Strong readable silhouettes at small sizes, delicate painterly edges matching the character art. Keep effect sizes and center aligned within each row's four cells. No trails across cells, every effect fully contained.
